title: collab-surge-proxy-gap-log-2026-11-09
body:
Purpose:
Lightweight one-sheet to track cross-functional proxy tasks when we see a short-term surge or coverage gap. Intended for ad-hoc coordination (not a replacement for the official on-call rota). Use when expected request delta > 15% for a 48–72 hour window and we need manual owner-level handoffs. Keep it short — 1 page for Slack / async handoffs.

How to use: 
- Populate a row per item. Keep estimates conservative.
- 'Proxy' means temporary owner stepping in to keep the flow until primary owner clears backlog or the Dedicated capacity scales.
- Only use for tasks that can be resolved in <= 8 hours of focused work or have a clear rollback.

Columns (sheet view):
- item_id: short id (e.g., P1, P2)
- item: 1–line description
- current_owner: who normally owns it
- proxy_owner: person stepping in (if assigned)
- est_hours: quick estimate to resolve
- priority: high / med / low (for surge triage)
- blocker: brief note of blocker (human/infra/contract)
- linked_jira: quick ticket id if exists
- last_update: YYYY-MM-DD
- next_action: one-line next step
- done: yes/no

Sample rows (realistic, minimal):
- P1 | API retry spike on /v1/generate | infra-team | Marco Reyes | 3h | high | rate-limit config changed in prod | JIRA-OPS-3184 | 2026-11-09 | roll back config and monitor | no
- P2 | Unexpected embedding cost bump for enterprise route | billing | Priya Shah | 4h | med | missing cache key leading to cold-starts | BILL-129 | 2026-11-09 | add TTL cache and reprocess top subsets | no
- P3 | Canary rollout stuck for v2.3 | release-eng | Ana Gómez | 2h | high | canary agent not pinging | REL-472 | 2026-11-10 | restart agent and re-evaluate canary metrics | no

Quick heat summary (manual count):
- High-priority open items: 3
- Estimated collective work: ~9 hours (conservative)
- Teams involved: infra, billing, release-eng, SRE on-call (for escalation)

Weekend coverage note:
If surge persists into weekend, escalate to weekend-ops@redwood with this sheet snapshot in the thread and assign a weekend proxy (preferably cross-trained SRE or solutions-eng). Add a single fallback contact per team to reduce coordination overhead.

Escalation contacts (compact):
- Infra lead (pager backup): Marco Reyes (slack: @marco)
- Billing contact: Priya Shah (slack: @priyash)
- Release engineering primary: Ana Gómez (slack: @ana)
notes:
Open questions:
- Should we automatically open a short-lived dedicated capacity request when estimated total > 20h? (ask infra capacity team)
next_steps: 1) Circulate this sheet in #ops-surge with top-3 items pinned. 2) Marco to attempt rollback on P1 by 11/09 EOD. 3) Priya to submit a short-term cache patch PR and attach to this doc. 4) Re-evaluate at 2026-11-12 09:00 PT.
mini_estimates: Potential cost impact if unresolved: $1.2k/day (embedding path, rough)
